title: What Does "Maxxing" Mean? Gen Z Slang Explained #shorts
description:
What does maxxing mean? He built a toy train that brings dinner to the table.
• -maxxing: making one thing as good as it can be (Gen Z slang)
• Example: "Comfort-maxxing" = making life as comfortable as it can be

What are you maxxing right now?
